what: The noise generator's first frames and a digest of more, for the two runs the design named (seed and sigma per profile) before anything was run.
how: Worked by tests/test_mod_a_reference.py, which imports nothing of model/: numpy uint64 words, a table rounded from a 50-digit decimal recomputation of the law, numpy's search. sha256_4096 is the SHA-256 of the canonical bytes of frames 0 to 4095: each sample two's complement, little-endian, in whole bytes, frame by frame, channel by channel.
